# krcw: paced
# KRCW Europe FRA/ENG on_actions (generated by build/content_europe.py -> eu_p6_fra_events.py)
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { country_exists = FRA } FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_fra.12 days = 384 random_days = 1 } } }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = ENG } ENG = { country_event = { id = krcw_eng.5 days = 703 random_days = 25 } } }
		}
	}
}
